name: view-image
description: View workspace images and current conversation image attachments through multimodal Responses tool results.
description_cn: 读取工作区或当前会话附件中的图片，并通过 Responses 协议将图片传给模型。

presentation.summary: 让支持图片输入的 Responses 模型查看本地图片和会话附件。
presentation.access_note: 读取指定图片并保存会话快照，将图片发送给当前配置的模型服务。

workflow: Use view_image to inspect workspace images or image attachments already present in the current conversation.
Pass a workspace-relative image path or the full attachment path. The tool returns actual image content, not only a path or text description.
The current model must support image input and use the Responses protocol. Report tool errors instead of claiming to have seen an unavailable image.
